card: Send a batch of messages from your Android device.
title: SMS App from your own phone
intro: SMS App sends single, batch and scheduled messages through a registered Android device. It keeps the sending device in the workflow.

sections.heading: What can SMS App send?
sections.body: Single messages, batches and scheduled sends are all supported.

sections.heading: Where are messages sent from?
sections.body: The Android device you register sends the SMS messages.

sections.heading: How are devices managed?
sections.body: Device registration and a volunteer pool are part of its management tools.

sections.heading: Where does SMS App fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell keeps reminders and people in one record. SMS App handles sending single, batch or scheduled texts from an Android device.
